title: An integrated investigation of structural and pathway alteration caused by PIK3CA and TP53 mutations identified in cfDNA of metastatic breast cancer.
authors: R, Hephzibah Cathryn; Kumar S, Udhaya; R, Gnanasambandan; Naayanan, P Jeyaprakash; Sathiyarajeswaren, P; Devi, M S Shree; K, Satish Srinivas; Doss C, George Priya
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过分子对接和MD模拟分析PIK3CA和TP53突变对蛋白结构及通路的影响，虽涉及TP53-DNA结合区域突变，但核心是癌症突变效应而非TF-DNA互作建模，方法为常规物理模拟，与课题关联有限。
abstract: In peripheral blood, cell-free DNA (cfDNA) contains circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA), which indicates molecular abnormalities in metastatic breast tumor tissue. The sequencing of cfDNA of Metastatic Breast Cancer (MBC) patients allows assessment of therapy response and noninvasive treatment. In the proposed study, clinically significant alterations in PIK3CA and TP53 genes associated with MBC resulting in a missense substitution of His1047Arg and Arg282Trp from an next-generation sequencing-based multi-gene panel were reported in a cfDNA of a patient with MBC. To investigate the impact of the reported mutation, we used molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulation, network analysis, and pathway analysis. Molecular Docking analysis determined the distinct binding pattern revealing H1047R-ATP complex has a higher number of Hydrogen bonds (H-bonds) and binding affinity with a slight difference compared to the PIK3CA-ATP complex. Following, molecular dynamics simulation for 200 ns, of which H1047R-ATP complex resulted in the instability of PIK3CA. Similarly, for TP53 mutant R282W, the zinc-free state (apo) and zinc-bounded (holo) complexes were investigated for conformational change between apo and holo complexes, of which the holo complex mutant R282W was unstable. To validate the conformational change of PIK3CA and TP53, 80% mutation of H1047R in the kinase domain of p110alpha expressed ubiquitously in PIK3CA protein that alters PI3K pathway, while R282W mutation in DNA binding helix (H2) region of P53 protein inhibits the transcription factor in P53 pathway causing MBC. According to our findings, the extrinsic (hypoxia, oxidative stress, and acidosis); intrinsic factors (MYC amplification) in PIK3CA and TP53 mutations will provide potential insights for developing novel therapeutic methods for MBC therapy.
abstract_zh: 在外周血中，游离DNA（cfDNA）含有循环肿瘤DNA（ctDNA），其指示转移性乳腺肿瘤组织中的分子异常。对转移性乳腺癌（MBC）患者的cfDNA进行测序，可评估治疗反应和无创治疗。在本研究中，基于下一代测序的多基因面板，报告了一名MBC患者cfDNA中与MBC相关的PIK3CA和TP53基因的临床显著改变，导致His1047Arg和Arg282Trp的错义替换。为探究所报告突变的影响，我们使用了分子对接、分子动力学模拟、网络分析和通路分析。分子对接分析确定了不同的结合模式，显示H1047R-ATP复合物具有更高数量的氢键（H-bonds）和结合亲和力，与PIK3CA-ATP复合物相比略有差异。随后，进行200 ns的分子动力学模拟，其中H1047R-ATP复合物导致PIK3CA不稳定。类似地，对于TP53突变体R282W，研究了无锌状态（apo）和锌结合状态（holo）复合物在apo和holo复合物之间的构象变化，其中holo复合物突变体R282W不稳定。为验证PIK3CA和TP53的构象变化，p110alpha激酶域中H1047R的80%突变在PIK3CA蛋白中普遍表达，改变PI3K通路，而P53蛋白DNA结合螺旋（H2）区域的R282W突变抑制P53通路中的转录因子，导致MBC。根据我们的发现，PIK3CA和TP53突变中的外在因素（缺氧、氧化应激和酸中毒）和内在因素（MYC扩增）将为开发MBC治疗的新方法提供潜在见解。
